summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str() of objects with sep, then delegates once to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow "ignore", crop off, and passes style, highlight (default True), and end through). Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_* aspects; RenderHook and Text imports added at top). Added "Added Console.out" to CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added list, and a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after logging. Tests were not run, per instructions; all changes were verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
